name: Runner Extras - PageExtension Control Source Expression
brief: Issue #4145: a TestPage could not find a control a pageextension declares bound to the EXTENSION's own global variable -- NavTestFieldNotFoundException -- because NavForm.CallInitializeComponentExtensionMethod, where each NavFormExtension.InitializeComponent registers the extension's source expressions, sat behind the narrow per-instance opt-in and so never ran during the page constructor.
description: The BC-behaviour half of this claim is upstream: corpus PR StefanMaron/BusinessCentral.AL.Language.Tests#359 (codeunit 60978, PageExtControl_*) measured a real service tier on all 8 cloud legs and established that BC finds BOTH controls a pageextension declares in one addlast(Content) block -- one bound to an extension global, one bound to a SourceTable field. That pair is what separated this issue's two candidate causes: the Rec-bound arm being found rules out 'the page metadata does not carry extension controls'. This suite is the runner-side mechanism test the require-tests gate needs, and it pins the runner-INTERNAL consequence of the guard widening: the SAME Cecil-guarded method must run during the constructor for a form the runner is about to drive, exactly as InitializeForm already does since #4114.
